title: メジロマックイーン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and I have begun our foray into the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To become a racer worthy of the noble Mejiro family name, she sets the goal of conquering the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first step of preparing for the Tenno Sho is to win her upcoming debut race.
